errors.text_span: като всяка серия се колебае по оста X
errors.evidence: The phrase, which translates to 'as each series fluctuates along the X-axis', is awkward. A more natural phrasing would be that the values of each series fluctuate across the categories represented on the X-axis.

The description states that the orange line has a peak of approximately 0.46 around category 60. The chart shows that the highest peak for the orange line is at category 31 (value ~0.47). There is a peak near the end of the axis, at category 58, but its value is much lower, around 0.35.

The description states that the lines have 'small markers' but does not specify that the marker shapes are different for each line (circles for blue, triangles for orange, and plus/square markers for green). This is an element of the chart's encoding used to distinguish the series.
The horizontal average lines are dashed, not dotted. This error is repeated for the orange and green average lines as well.

errors.text_span: rising to around 0.38 near the mid-left portion (around category ~16)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps a value of 0.38 to the orange line at category 16. The actual value for the orange line at category 16 is approximately 0.28.

errors.text_span: reaching a high close to 0.46 around category ~31
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes a peak to the orange line at category 31. In the plot, it is the blue line that has a major peak close to 0.5 at category 31, while the orange line has a value of approximately 0.2.

The description mentions 'small point markers' but omits specifying their distinct shapes (circles, triangles, squares), which are used to differentiate the lines and are mentioned in the reference description.
The description states that the orange line has 'x-markers' ('x-Markern'), but the plot clearly shows it has triangle markers.

The description claims that the orange line has a prominent peak reaching 'knapp unter 0,5' (just under 0.5) 'im Bereich um die 60' (in the area around 60). The plot shows that the value for the orange line around category 60 is much lower (approx. 0.25), and the highest peaks are located elsewhere, for example around categories 30 and 40.
The description states that the green line has 'triangle-markers' ('Dreieck-Markern'), but the plot shows it has circle markers.
